# SAVOR JAPAN

> SAVOR JAPAN is a comprehensive Japanese restaurant reservation and dining guide designed for foreign visitors exploring Japan's diverse culinary landscape across regions like Tokyo, Osaka, Hiroshima, and beyond.

The platform provides English-language restaurant search, reservation services, and travel guides highlighting local cuisine, cultural attractions, and regional specialties from Hokkaido to Kyushu. SAVOR JAPAN helps international travelers discover authentic Japanese dining experiences with English menu support and curated special features.

## Key Topics

- Japanese cuisine
- Restaurant reservations
- Dining guide for foreign visitors
- Regional food culture
- English menu availability
- Travel & things to do
- Local specialties (Horai Beef, etc.)
- Major cities (Tokyo, Osaka, Hiroshima)
- Restaurant finder
- Authentic Japanese dining
- Cultural attractions
- Regional guides (Aichi, Kanagawa, Kochi, Toyama)
- World heritage sites
- Special dining features
